description: "Eugene Aram" by Edward Bulwer Lytton is a novel written in the early 19th century that delves into the life of a character fraught with contradictions. The story revolves around Eugene Aram, a complex scholar whose brilliance is overshadowed by the shadow of a crime—the murder for gain—which creates a moral enigma for the reader.
